README.md.content:
# Storefront

Checkout, catalog and account pages for the storefront.

## Development

- `pnpm install`
- `pnpm dev` starts the app on port 5173
- `pnpm test` runs the unit tests

See [the guide](docs/guide.pdf) for the OAuth checkout flow.

docs/notes.md.content:
# Notes

- Coupons apply before tax.
- OAuth tokens expire after an hour.
